name: Figma FigJam
description: Figma FigJam is a vendor-qualified name for FigJam, Figma's collaborative online whiteboard for brainstorming, diagrams, workshops, planning, meetings, research, and visual teamwork.
agentUseSummary: Do not create a separate Figma FigJam connection or install. Select the canonical FigJam provider, which validates editorType figjam and owns the bounded Figma OAuth board, comment, version, render, and webhook workflows. Relay does not expose external canvas creation or editing because those operations require a plugin or widget running inside FigJam.

blocked.label: Create a separate Figma FigJam connection
blocked.description: Figma FigJam and FigJam identify the same provider product, Figma OAuth authority, board files, comments, versions, renders, and webhooks; a second connection would duplicate identity and state.

blocked.label: Install duplicate FigJam tools
blocked.description: Relay mounts supported FigJam REST operations once through the canonical FigJam provider rather than publishing parallel vendor-qualified tools and policies.

blocked.label: Edit the FigJam canvas remotely
blocked.description: Figma exposes sticky, shape, connector, code-block, media, table, timer, widget, and other canvas creation or editing through in-editor Plugin and Widget APIs, not the external OAuth REST surface.

blocked.label: Run separate Figma FigJam actions
blocked.description: Supported board reads and approved comment, reaction, or webhook writes belong to the selected canonical FigJam connection and its existing Safe or Dangerously skip permissions profile.

approvalProfiles.label: Use FigJam
approvalProfiles.description: No separate Figma FigJam action is enabled because this source name identifies the already converged canonical FigJam provider.

runtimeSupport.description: No duplicate Figma FigJam tools are mounted. OpenClaw uses the canonical FigJam provider for supported bounded REST workflows.
No duplicate Figma FigJam tools are mounted. Hermes uses the canonical FigJam provider for supported bounded REST workflows.

providerSetup.blocker: Figma FigJam is a vendor-qualified label for FigJam, not a separate provider identity, account, authorization, or resource system. Publishing another card, Figma OAuth grant, credential record, callback, installation, policy, audit identity, or runtime adapter would duplicate the canonical FigJam provider. Canvas mutation remains unavailable to external OAuth REST clients regardless of the display name.
providerSetup.nextAction: Keep this alias slug non-installable and direct discovery, setup, connection, installation, and execution to the canonical FigJam provider. Use exact bounded FigJam board, node, image, version, render, comment, reaction, and webhook routes under the selected FigJam connection and policy. Revisit only if Figma separates a product with distinct identity and authority or publishes stable external canvas mutation endpoints and granular scopes approved by Relay.

evidence.supports: Figma's official product page names the collaborative whiteboard product FigJam and describes brainstorming, diagramming, planning, and real-time teamwork.
Figma's help center identifies FigJam as its online-whiteboard product with FigJam files, shared account access, collaboration, stickies, shapes, drawings, images, and other visual elements.
Figma's external file API returns an editorType with authorized file metadata and JSON node data through one Figma file-key and OAuth model, allowing the canonical connector to require figjam.
Figma documents FigJam-specific sticky, shape, connector, code-block, media, table, timer, and other canvas operations through plugins running in the FigJam editor rather than external REST.
Figma's granular file, comment, version, and webhook scopes apply through the same Figma authorization and never exceed provider-side board permissions.
